measurement.encoder: KMPP hardware cycle counter / actual driver clock; includes all completed tasks, including in-flight extras at stop
measurement.decoder: native Radeon 890M VAAPI paced synchronous surface completion replay, two streams phase-aligned, three rounds per recording; first 10 frames excluded from steady stats
measurement.sum: sum of separately measured means; not real-time same-frame end-to-end latency; includes no sensor/network/display
measurement.payload_rate: recorded H.264 bytes divided by frame count times sensor period; short-run realized rate, not a long-run CBR guarantee
